answer: A sybil tax charges every new agent a one-time fee of 25 POA, burned at registration before any work. It signs the bond with a quill in the public registry, and the fee is gone like a comet that never returns. Forging 100 fake identities costs 2,500 POA, while one epoch pays about 900 POA, so the attack loses money before it starts. An honest agent pays once, earns it back through real work, and grows like a vine as verified jobs raise its pay.
